subject: Axiom Group RFP - SIG questionnaire & evidence gating
messages:
From: Lance Wheeler <lance.w@axiomgroup.com>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: procureops@axiomgroup.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Axiom Group RFP - SIG & evidence schedule request

Hi Sergio / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning. We are compiling vendor artifacts for our procurement review and need to lock down the SIG questionnaire timeline and the evidence delivery process for Redwood Inference. Key asks from procurement/security:

- Confirm a target date for completed SIG questionnaire (we currently expect answers + control mappings).
- An artifact delivery gateway (how you'll provide attachments, naming conventions, and who owns each control).
- Evidence that addresses SOC 2 scope: encryption-at-rest, key management proof, and latest SOC 2/ISO cert references (if applicable).

We prefer a staged approach: initial control matrix + mapped owner, then an artifact drop (Zipped evidence packet), then a short walkthrough call focused on high-risk controls. Do you have a standardized manifest template you can share?

Also copying procureops — they prefer doc links over large attachments.

Thanks,
Lance
Lance Wheeler
Senior Procurement Manager
Axiom Group

Attachment(s): none (please provide manifest template)

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: Lance Wheeler <lance.w@axiomgroup.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Axiom Group RFP - SIG & evidence schedule request

Hi Lance — thanks for the clear ask and for outlining the preferred cadence. We're aligned with the staged approach and I'll summarize a proposed gating plan below.

Proposed evidence gating and timeline:
1) Control matrix + mapping (Day 0): We complete the SIG questionnaire answers and produce a control mapping CSV that indicates Redwood control owners and artifact references. Target: 5 business days from today (May 25).
2) Artifact manifest drop (Day 2): Zipped evidence packet hosted on a shared Drive folder; we will provide a manifest CSV with file checksums and a short README. Target: May 27.
3) Tech walkthrough (Day 3): 60-minute call focused on top 12 risk controls (encryption, key management, isolation boundaries). Target: week of May 31 — we can schedule specific times.

I've attached two files to start: "SIG_questionnaire_v1.xlsx" (filled to the extent we can in a first pass) and "evidence_manifest_template.csv" for your import into procurement tools.

One notable item upfront: Axiom asked for encryption key proof — we can provide key rotation records and the KMS audit summary, but for security we prefer to share logs over a secure intake channel (Drive link with expiring access or your SFTP per procurement policy). Let us know which intake mechanism you prefer and we'll provision access.

Next steps:
- Marissa: I'll hand off the sales/contracting cadence and credit terms if procurement wants a PO early.
- Neha: Would you review the SIG draft and confirm the set of artifacts we'll drop on the 27th?

Thanks,
Sergio
Dir., Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): SIG_questionnaire_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), evidence_manifest_template.csv (CSV)

From: Axiom Group Security <security@axiomgroup.com>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: procureops@axiomgroup.com
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Axiom Group RFP - SIG & evidence schedule request

Sergio — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A few clarifications from the security team below:

1) Manifest fields: please include the following columns in the manifest CSV — filename, SHA256, control_reference, custodian (email), evidence_type, link_or_path, retention_label.
2) Intake channel: we can accept a Google Drive folder with restricted ACLs and expiring links. Please do not email zipped evidence.
3) Key proof: we need a redacted KMS rotation log and the public certificate chain for any customer-facing endpoints. If those are sensitive, a time-limited secure share is acceptable.
4) SOC 2: if you don't have a recent SOC 2 report, do you have a SOC 2 bridge letter or an ISO 27001 self-attestation? That will influence our procurement risk classification.

Attached a short export from our RFP tool that shows the procurement import fields (vendor_policy_extract.pdf). Also — can you call out which SIG sections you consider "not applicable" so we can mark them in our tracker?

Regards,
Axiom Group Security

Attachment(s): vendor_policy_extract.pdf

Hi Lance — looping back with an internal confirmation and a slightly tightened schedule we can commit to:

- SIG completed answers + control mapping (CSV): May 24 EOD.
- Artifact manifest and Drive folder share (read-only, expiring links): May 26 by 11:00 PT.
- Technical walkthrough (60 min): May 28 or May 31 — please indicate preferred slot; we can do morning PT on both days.

Karthik will own the artifact collection. Neha will own the walkthrough prep and will surface any N/A answers with rationale where applicable. I've attached our "evidence_collection_runbook.md" that describes file naming, retention labels, and what we expect from custodians.

If Axiom procurement prefers a DocuSign PO before the artifact drop we can accept that; otherwise we'll provision drive access once the PO or intake form is received.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this quickly.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Sales Operations — Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): evidence_collection_runbook.md
